# RackRoom Safety

> Training for data center facilities teams: spill prevention for generator fuel, spill kits, universal waste batteries, awareness, gas detection and RCRA generator training, with battery room and SPCC guides.

RackRoom Safety (https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Spill Prevention, Universal Waste, Awareness, Gas Detection or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA Spill Prevention and Response Safety Training](https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training): $29.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 40 CFR 112. Preventing and responding to fuel and electrolyte spills. Enroll: https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-spill-prevention-and-response-safety-training?buy=416
- [RCRA Universal Waste Handler Training](https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 273 (RCRA). Managing spent UPS batteries and lamps as universal waste. Enroll: https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training?buy=602
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). Recognize a hazardous release and get clear. Enroll: https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Hydrogen, refrigerant and oxygen monitoring. Enroll: https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056
- [RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training](https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training): $134.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 40 CFR 262.17 (RCRA). Hazardous waste generator training for campus facilities. Enroll: https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-hazardous-waste-generator-training?buy=601

## Guides

- [Battery room hazards in data centers](https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/guides/data-center-battery-room-hazards): Lead-acid and lithium-ion UPS batteries carry different risks. What facilities teams need to know.
- [Generator fuel and SPCC at data centers](https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/guides/data-center-generator-fuel-spcc): Backup generator fuel storage often triggers EPA's spill prevention rule. What that means.
- [Refrigerants, glycol and clean agents: other chemicals in the data center](https://data-centers.hazwoperosha.us/guides/other-chemicals-in-the-data-center): Cooling and fire suppression systems bring their own hazards. A quick overview.
